standard_references.artifact_id: Standardising Reference Metadata Reporting in SDMX
standard_references.evidence: Supplied reference catalog identifies this SDMX guideline as a source for reference metadata vocabulary and reporting practice; no fetched official-source excerpt confirming the exact concept IDs used in this metadata set was supplied.

Fetched official-source excerpt confirms the SDMX Glossary Version 2.1 includes entries for Metadata Set, Metadata Structure Definition, Metadata update, Institutional mandate, Labour force status, and a Geographical coverage entry with Concept ID COVERAGE_GEO and recommended representation String/Codelist.
Fetched official-source excerpt confirms the SDMX Global Registry provides a codelist catalogue and includes metadata-related artefact categories such as Metadata Structures and Metadataflow.

limitations: Exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme identifiers and versions are not confirmed from the supplied fetched external evidence for most metadata concepts; the concept IDs follow the accepted MSD for this package and remain candidate/local where noted there.
No contact point is stated in the supplied report context, so CONTACT is not populated as a metadata value.
No metadata update date distinct from the publication date is stated in the supplied report context, so META_UPDATE is not populated as a metadata value.
Geographic coverage is derived only from region labels appearing in the table; no authoritative geographic classification or code mapping is confirmed for Northland, Centralia or South Coast.
Industry labels are retained as local aggregate wording from the report; no ISIC mapping is asserted.

Observation-level status values such as Final and Provisional are not converted into reference metadata except where the source report provides table-level or dataflow-level notes and revision-policy text.
